recognize_zh: 一排四個顆粒性白血球，細胞質內都有深紫黑色的粗顆粒；右側兩個細胞的黑色顆粒集中成帶狀覆蓋在核的一側，左側細胞核較圓、似較不成熟的骨髓系細胞；多個細胞同時出現相同黑色團塊，支持為外來色素而非單一細胞異常。
features: Four granulocytes in a row, including a band/segmented form and cells with rounder nuclei suggestive of metamyelocyte or myelocyte stage
Coarse dark purple-black granular clumps, in the right two cells aggregated in a band over one side of the nucleus
Background fine pink-lilac granules in the remaining cytoplasm
Occasional smudged pale cell and scattered platelets
Red cells normochromic with some echinocytes
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows four granulocytes at different stages of maturation, including forms with rounder nuclei consistent with immature myeloid cells, each containing coarse dark purple-black cytoplasmic granular material. In two cells the dark material is aggregated in a band overlying one side of the nucleus, with finer pink granules in the remaining cytoplasm. A smudged cell, scattered platelets, and echinocytes are present in the background. The shared, clumped dark material across neutrophils and immature granulocytes, in a septic patient sampled after iodinated contrast, is consistent with pigment inclusions with left-shifted toxic granulopoiesis.

ddx.vs: Basophils have granules evenly overlying the whole cell and are not accompanied by a left-shifted neutrophil series with identical clumps.
Toxic granules are finer and diffusely scattered, lacking discrete black aggregates.
Hemozoin is brown-black and refractile, usually with visible intraerythrocytic parasites.
